notes.title: Wishlist and ChinaJoy update!
notes.content: [h2][b]Wishlist and ChinaJoy update[/b][/h2][p] [/p][p]Hey Yolkfolk,[/p][p][/p][p]We’re EGGcited to share that we’ve passed 50,000 wishlists! This is a huge achievement for us and we’re so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown Egging On so far and can’t wait to share the full game with you later this year 😊[/p][p][/p][p]We’re also thrilled to be included in the ChinaJoy Steam event, so to celebrate such a big moment for us, we’ve put our Next Fest demo back up on our store page for the duration of ChinaJoy.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo will only be available again for a limited time until August 5th, so get rolling 🥚![/p][p][/p][p]If you want to stay up to date on future announcements and news, make sure to join our [url="https://discord.gg/nWXHACwngK"]discord server [/url]![/p]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content: [p]Dearest Yolkfolk! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has supported Egging On so far! The positive response we’ve seen during our open playtest & recent Steam Next Fest demo has been incredible, and we cannot thank you enough for all the support you’ve shown us! [/p][p][/p][p]During this time by far one of the most requests we received was about whether we could also bring Egging On to consoles. This led to a lot of discussions internally about what’s best for Egging On and you the players, and in the end, we decided that it would be best to bring Egging On to as many players as possible at launch. And so, we are excited to announce that we’ll be doing exactly that! It’s a bit too early to confirm specific consoles Egging On will be coming to just yet, but please stay tuned for our next update for more details.[/p][p][/p][p]Due to this we have also made the difficult decision to push back our Steam release to coincide with the console launches. Whilst we really do appreciate this may be a source of disappointment for our community, this will also give us more time to add additional content and polish to the game. There were several fun features that we had in mind that we didn't have time to fit in before the original release date that we can now bring into the game for launch. [/p][p][/p][p]Although it’s a shame to delay our Steam release, we’re confident that with this additional time we will be able to release an even bigger, better & eggier experience for all our players across PC and Consoles. We don't have an exact release date - we will be announcing this very soon - but we are confidently aiming for Q4 2025. [/p][p][/p][p]We want to share a heartfelt thank you to our community for your support and enthusiasm for Egging On. We cannot wait to share the full release with you soon! ❤️🥚[/p]

notes.title: Demo Out Now & Speedrunning Competition!
notes.content: [h3]Greetings YolkFolk! [/h3][p][/p][p]As promised in our last news post, we’ve got an egg-citing surprise for you… we’ve decided to [b]drop our Next Fest demo early[/b] alongside a [b]limited-time speedrunning competition[/b]! [/p][p]The demo is [b]available to play right now[/b], and contains: [/p][list][*][p]The fan-favourite [b]Hen-House[/b] area, the first full zone of this challenging climbing platformer. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The brand-new [b]Playground[/b] tutorial zone, with its variety of obstacles! [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]15 secret eggshell skins[/b] to customise and show of your egg with! Oh, and one is a rocketship?!?  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fully voiced [b]narrative[/b] providing story & universe building. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]In-game timer[/b] option to see who amongst your friends can complete the demo the fastest! [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949710/db7e4739245626b4813869e07eb1fdec263cba6d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Speedrunning Competition[/b] [/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="lixVh_v8XIg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]To celebrate our demo launch, we’re also running a speedrunning competition for you all to participate in, with [b]$1,062 in cash-prizes available[/b] to the fastest eggs in the hen-house! Check out the video above for more details: [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Competition Rules:[/b] [/h3][p]A gameplay video will need to be shared via the following form: [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSewG-118TzOAcaA5uHEyzyW-TXtAxeR2_VB_fLbH7GAkuQSqg/viewform?usp=dialog"]here[/url] (Chinese players can access via this [url="https://wj.qq.com/s2/22647220/6a6e/"]link[/url]). [/p][p]The full rules and requirements can be accessed via the following link: [url="https://docs.google.com/document/d/15-urzexNp0Yw_cLKkRqoov37fsFTFAJ9KgCiyvqmN8k/edit?usp=sharing"]here [/url](Chinese players can read [url="https://docs.qq.com/doc/DYXppZmpEeVFqVkVZ"]here[/url]). [/p][p] [/p][p]We hope you enjoy our Next Fest and give our speedrunning competition a try (don’t be a chicken…)! [/p][p]As always, we’d love to hear your thoughts over on our [url="https://discord.gg/8BZjqCxZR8"]Discord [/url]where you can chat to us directly! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Good luck and have fun![/b] [/p]

notes.title: Release Date & Steam Next Fest Announcement!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello YolkFolk! [/h3]

We’re excited to announce that Egging On will be [b]officially launching on August 7th 2025[/b]! 

To celebrate this, please take a look at our brand-new trailer!

[previewyoutube=T_i2QiQ0Cdg;full][/previewyoutube]

The good news doesn’t stop there though - Egging On will also be featuring in the [b]upcoming June Next Fest[/b] with its very first, hard-boiled demo! Stay tuned for another exciting announcement about this on June 6th 2025... 

This demo will contain the fan-favourite hen-house level, a brand-new playground area as well as a bunch of new shells to discover and unlock (including the special rocket shell below)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949710/f233a0f1c77b34e515673768a593bc9adc705e29.jpg[/img]

We are incredibly grateful for all the support you have shown us, and for all the feedback you’ve given us during our playtests!

As always, we'd love to hear your thoughts on the demo in our [url=https://discord.gg/2sBUErqXPN]Discord[/url] - please join to share feedback and chat directly with us!

[b]The Egobounds Team[/b]

notes.title: Open Playtest Egg-stension!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello Yolkfolk![/b][/h3]

Thank you to everyone who played the public playtest over the Easter break - we've had a blast watching you through joy, pain and elation!

"[i]Maybe we should keep the playtest open a bit longer?[/i]" said Piotr.

[b]Piotr has a point.[/b]

So for those who enjoyed playing Egging On but wished they could play again, or for those who maybe didn't get a chance to try it out over the weekend; we've decided to [b]extend the public playtest by 48 hours[/b]!

The playtest will now continue to be available to access, play and stream until [b]Thursday 24th April 15.00 BST[/b]!

We've been blown away by all the support over the last few days - thank you to everyone who's played or covered Egging On during the Easter break!

If you would like to share your playtest feedback, and chat directly with us, don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/2sBUErqXPN]Discord[/url]!

[b]Happy rolling![/b]

notes.title: Playtest Updated!
notes.content:
[h1]A New Round of Yolkfolk![/h1]
 
The first playtest session was such a cracking success we've decided to announce we’re extending the playtest with a new round of Yolkfolk joining the fun!
 
Thanks to the incredible feedback, we’ve already rolled out some updates to the test build, now live for everyone to enjoy. These include smoother control tweaks, handy new tips and tricks, and...wait, is that a drone buzzing around?
 
We would really appreciate if those that test the game could fill in the [url=https://forms.gle/DQ4JWutpbQwKDo9RA]Feedback Form[/url]. Every comment helps us make the game eggstra special! 

A quick reminder that since this is a playtest with some placeholder features, please refrain from streaming or sharing videos publicly. If you want to cover Egging On please fill out our [url=https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=GTeEkjBVE0KCA4Kt4D-WkOFDtkrvmRBFlJQ75BceJ-1UNzJRR1ZVV01QTUpDVVVVUk00NURMTzFHTC4u&route=shorturl]Creators Form[/url] or catch us on [url=https://discord.gg/2sBUErqXPN]Discord[/url] for a chat.
 
Thank you so much for being part of the Egging On playtest. Have fun!

notes.title: Playtesting Now Live!
notes.content:

The time has come! We've begun sending out invites to our first playtest (please note these invites are random!).

We'd really appreciate if those who do take part fill out our [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeUwp5EZaFd2vH76SDGYnZ27vd5xNK85ZETmQGbdPiFKyLwGg/viewform?usp=dialog]Feedback Form[/url] to help us create the best possible egg-experience for you! By filling out the form, you'll also be the first to be notified of any future playtesting opportunities.

If you weren't selected this time around - don't fret! We'll be doing future playtesting sessions, so make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/2sBUErqXPN]Discord[/url] to keep up to date with any announcements!

Finally, just a quick reminder: we ask that you please don't stream or share videos publicly of this playtest. If you are interested in covering Egging On, please fill out our [url=https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=GTeEkjBVE0KCA4Kt4D-WkOFDtkrvmRBFlJQ75BceJ-1UNzJRR1ZVV01QTUpDVVVVUk00NURMTzFHTC4u&route=shorturl]Creators Form[/url].

As always, thanks for your support, and we're egg-cited to hear your feedback for Egging On!

notes.title: Sign-Up Now For Closed Playtesting!
notes.content:
[h3]Calling all Yolkfolk![/h3]

We've been hard at work these last few months building out the best possible egg-experience for you all, and we're excited to announce that we're opening [b]sign-ups for closed playtests[/b]!

We're dedicated to creating Egging On alongside our community, and are excited to get your input on how we can make Egging On an egg-cellent experience for everyone!

Thank you as always for your support, and we can't wait to see you in the hen house 🥚

notes.title: Egobounds + Alibi Games partner to publish Egging On!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Yolkfolk! 🥚[/h3]

Egging On is about to crack open the gaming world!

As we advance on this eggciting journey, we're super proud and happy to share that Egobounds has joined forces with Alibi games to publish Egging On!

[i](Yes, we will be trying to keep the puns to a tolerable level, we promise.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949710/1053429d21f6ebf6f5022d15ac8f293cee38358c.png[/img]
[h2]Why this partnership?[/h2]

When we first connected with Alibi, they told us something that stuck with us: they only sign games they truly fall in love with and believe in. What felt "too good to be true" at first has proven to be real, with their support and encouragement showing up everyday and helping us bring the best possible version of [i]Egging On[/i].

As Egobounds, we’re laser-focused on making [i]Egging On[/i] a polished, immersive, and one-of-a-kind experience. But we’re not just about eggs—we're all about developing a game that surprises and challenges players in innovative ways. Alibi has been the perfect partner to help us take that vision and run with it. 

With their support, we’re ready to hatch something truly special for you all!


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949710/b131f99a4bb33e1c3de51023669f0bdfcb5834a7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949710/14709487689427d1bc3376b51a893ad92c232856.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45256644][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949710/33aea355a512febfddc731f7a0a72b2556cb9a52.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949710/87062e3b62fba8a1709f6c503750e7db3bf61293.png[/img][/url][/url]

If Egging On is cracking you up, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45256644]follow Alibi’s Steam page[/url] for more projects that’ll hatch soon—they're just getting started! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949710/1053429d21f6ebf6f5022d15ac8f293cee38358c.png[/img]
[h2]What's coming next?[/h2]

As development progresses, we’ll keep you updated with regular behind-the-scenes content, dev diaries, and you can also expect to see sneak peeks of new environments and many egg puns & memes.

We are trying to be as transparent as we can in our development process, so feel free to ask anything!


[i][b]And since we're sharing, here’s a sneak peek from a brand-new level we haven’t revealed yet.[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949710/cd9f9b97e3bae65e887638dfe1e610e41569f3b0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949710/1053429d21f6ebf6f5022d15ac8f293cee38358c.png[/img]

There are 2 things you can do to support us and contribute right now!

Join our official [url=https://discord.gg/JT2ErdVxSC]Discord server[/url], become a Yolkfolk! And get ready to scramble into discussions, share your feedback, or get involved in future playtesting sessions![/olist]
